"`(|ARMOUR→RESIST − RESIST→ARMOUR|, class)` on the region-weighted expectation.

    ⚑ **`D-I23-1` — MY OWN PRE-REGISTERED `S-4` CONVICTED MY OWN PREDICTION, NOT THIS PIPELINE.**
    Math note § 3.3 derives `Δ = 0` on the `DLEP` branch, and that derivation is correct **over the
    reals**: both orders are a scalar multiply and real multiplication is associative. IEEE-754
    multiplication is **not** associative — `(1 − 0.98)` is already inexact and the two orderings
    round differently at the last bit — so the measured residual is 1–2 ULP (`~3.6e-15`), not zero.
    Addendum `bfad4664`, committed BEFORE this repair. **`S-4`'s wording is NOT rewritten**; it is
    graded a REPAIRED pass, exactly as `S-3` was at I-22.

    Three buckets, ULP-SCALED rather than absolute, so the reader sees the split instead of
    trusting a bucket name:

      * `bit_exact`  — `Δ == 0.0`
      * `ulp_only`   — `0 < Δ <= 4 · ulp(applied)`: a rounding artifact
      * `material`   — `Δ > 4 · ulp(applied)`: a real model difference

    ⚑ The discriminator is MEASURABLE, not rhetorical: a model difference on `DLEP` would scale
    with `p`; this one scales with the ULP of the RESULT.
    "

'Drive one wave: roll the board, spawn it on CITED geometry, move it, resolve the disc.

    ⚑ MONSTER ATTACK MODEL IS `abstract-schedule` AND NO PER-ATTACK GEOMETRY IS INVENTED. The sim
    owns *when* and *how much* through `hp_after` on the player's damage rows; monster-side
    telegraph geometry is NOT in the read set (HALT-7 is the pre-registered G-D contingency and does
    not fire pre-emptively), so this harness emits no monster-side geometry at all rather than a
    plausible-looking one.

    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    ⚑ THE BOARD MOVES (§ 10.9a; F-12 amendment). SEMANTIC SHIFT, NAMED — Discipline #12.
    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    Until this lap `disc.resolve_tick` was handed each actor's **SPAWN coordinate for every tick**,
    so the board was static and the player toured it at 2.5×–5.1× the farthest spawn distance,
    rising with body count. That build is retired. Three things changed meaning, not just value:

      1. **`actors[].arrive_t_s` → `spawn_t_s`.** Under the static board the two coincided: a body
         became live *and in position* at the same instant. Under motion they separate. The field
         now names `t_spawn`; arrival is a **derived measurement** (`contact_t_s` / `engage_t_s` on
         the `Mover`). `arrive_t_s` is retained for ONE lap as a deprecated alias so the shift shows
         up in a diff rather than silently at a call site. **MIGRATION.md entry filed.**
      2. **`Arena` carries CITED geometry, and `emitter_radius_m` is DELETED** (AC-10.10) — six
         placements per arena, p01 keyed per tier, in the `PatrolPoint_Attack` centroid frame.
      3. **p05's drip is PER BODY.** The old code read `sched[sp][0]` for every body on a point, so
         all p05 bodies shared the first slot. Body *k* now spawns at `4.0 + 3.0k` per AC-10.6's own
         choreography. It changes *when*, not *how many* — and under a motion model "when" is causal.

    ⚑ THE PLAYER CAMPS (JC-G1, DECLARED ONCE). § 10.9a D requires the lap to declare camp / kite /
    tour and convert once. CAMP is the policy the spec's own reasoning presumes ("a centrally-camped
    player", § 2.2 / § 10.9a A) and is the conservative limb for closure attribution: the player is
    credited with ZERO closing speed. TOUR is the retired static-board behaviour and is not offered.

    ⚑ `approach_speed_m_s` OVERRIDES `v_ref` FOR ONE CALL. It defaults to the declared
    `V_REF_M_PER_S`; the parameter exists so the calibration lane can run `v_ref` as a **negative
    control** on the fitting move without mutating a module constant. Passing it does not calibrate
    anything — charter § 4.2 still forbids fitting it to a pinned target, and § 10.9a F.2 forbids
    solving it against T-1 residuals.

    ⚑ `n_regulars_override` IS THE N-SENSITIVITY LIMB (§ 10.9a F.4) and nothing else. It perturbs
    the regular body count for ONE call so the lap can report how sensitive its result is to the
    F-13 residual. It does **not** re-pin a count; the count model is untouched.

    ⚑ `record_actor_paths` (R-L80-2) TURNS ON THE `Mover` KNOT RECORDER AND CHANGES NOTHING ELSE.
    Default `False`, so every pre-existing call site — including the Phase-E driver's `execute_run`
    — is byte-identical in behaviour by construction. The recorder writes down positions the sim
    already computes; it draws no RNG, feeds nothing back into the motion state, and adds no
    branch outside `if mover._knots is not None`. Math note

    `scripts/gamora_kc2_actor_path_knots_2026_08_08.py` proves it by OFF-vs-ON surface digest and
    by exact replay of the committed Phase-E artifact. It supplies star-lord's F5-E
    (`actors[].path[]`), for which EVENT-ROW-UNION was rejected at L-80(c).
    '

co_consts:
"⚑ **PURE** — applied lightning for one projectile on one body, counting NOTHING.

        Separated from `soulfire_damage_against` because the D-I11-1 contact instrument queries the
        same arithmetic and a counter that a *measurement* increments is a corrupted counter. The
        I-11 lesson (D-I11-2) was that a silent instrument defect is worse than a crash; this is the
        same hazard one level up.

        **No armour** — the record's absorption equations are `physicalDamageDefenseEquation*`,
        physical-scoped by their own field names.
        "
code.name: soulfire_applied

co_consts:
"One damage row against one body.  ⚑ **BOTH BRANCHES ARE IMPORTED LAWS.**

    * physical → :func:`player_offense.applied_damage`, the function itself (``B3app-P7``).
    * everything else → ``raw × max(0, 1 − res/100) × crit`` with **no armour**, which is
      ``secondary_streams.soulfire_applied``'s expression and carries its reason: the record's
      absorption equations are ``physicalDamageDefenseEquation*``, physical-scoped by their own
      field names.

    ⚑ ``C-B3app-2`` — ``magnitude_min`` and never a roll.  A LOWER bound, declared.
    "

co_consts:
"Math note § C.1 — armour on Physical only.

    ⚑ **KC2-MC B-1r (2026-08-24): `resist_bonus_pct` and `max_resist_bonus_pct` are ADDITIVE and
    default `0.0`.**  `x + 0.0` is `x` exactly in IEEE-754, so every pre-existing call site is
    byte-identical BY CONSTRUCTION.  They carry Resilience's decoded `defensivePhysical = +4 %`
    (Physical / SlowPhysical only) and `defensiveAllMaxResist = +2 %` (the cap) **while its 5 s
    window is open** — D-6, `player_kit_residual.RESILIENCE_WINDOW_BASIS`.  The physical-family
    gate below is the SAME pair the armour branch uses, so the two cannot diverge on which rows
    count as physical.

    ⚑ **KC2-PM4 · I-23 — THE DECLARED ORDER FLIPS. SEMANTIC SHIFT, NAMED (Discipline #12).**
    PM-2 declared RESISTANCE-FIRST, veto-open, for two stated reasons. Lap X did **not** refute
    it: Lap X graded the order `UNREACHED-X-4` and published BOTH limbs with a decoded fork
    magnitude (Δ 398.384 on a 5,000-pt hit). What changed is that the run now has a LINEAGE reason
    to prefer ARMOUR-then-RESIST — it is the limb every Lap X number already used, and
    `R-PM4-62 part 3` fixes it on that basis, in a math note containing zero grades. **This is not
    a bug fix and it is not buried as one.** The incumbent order stays runnable, both as
    `intake=None` and as `intake.OrderLimb.RESIST_THEN_ARMOUR`.

    ⚑ **`intake=None` IS THE PM-2 / I-22 ARITHMETIC, STATEMENT FOR STATEMENT** — same branches,
    same operand (the sheet's `PLAYER_ARMOR`), same attribution strings, zero RNG. That is what
    makes I-23's fold-OFF byte identity true BY CONSTRUCTION rather than by inspection.

    ⚑ **WITH `intake` SUPPLIED THE OPERAND IS THE ROLLED REGION'S PIECE ARMOUR** (1,722.24 –
    2,976.48), never the sheet's 3,557 (Lap X § 12.2 DO-NOT #2), and armour still touches Physical
    / SlowPhysical ONLY (DO-NOT #3) — the family gate below is unchanged and now runs BEFORE the
    resist multiply so the two paths cannot diverge on a non-physical row.

    ⚑ KC2-PM3 · `resist_cap_pct` defaults to `NO_RESIST_CAP_PCT` (100), which is EXACTLY what PM-2
    did. `PLAYER_DEFENSE_CAP_PCT` (80, MEASURED) is passed in only by a run that carries the
    R-PM3-2(A) correction, so every pre-existing call site is byte-identical by construction.
    "

"One d100 roll against PTH. Returns `(hit, damage_multiplier, crit_tier)`.
